item.label: Image
item.description: Upload your desired image, or type in the URL to the image you would like to display.

item.label: Alternative Text
item.description: This defines the HTML ALT text. A short description of your image can be placed here.

item.label: Title Text
item.description: This defines the HTML Title text.

item.label: Open in Lightbox
item.description: Here you can choose whether or not the image should open in Lightbox. Note: if you select to open the image in Lightbox, url options below will be ignored.

item.label: Image Link URL
item.description: If you would like your image to be a link, input your destination URL here. No link will be created if this field is left blank.

item.label: Image Link Target
item.description: Here you can choose whether or not your link opens in a new window

item.label: Direction
item.description: You can control the direction of Reveal Animation

item.label: Delay (Sec)
item.description: You can control the delay of the Reveal Image Animation

item.label: Animation Time (Sec)
item.description: You can control the time of Animation to Reveal the Image

item.label: Animate in Viewport (%)
item.description: You can set the position of the Viewport(Display position) when Image will Reveal

item.label: Rounded Corners
item.description: Here you can control the corner radius of this element. Enable the link icon to control all four corners at once, or disable to define custom values for each.

item.label: Enable
item.description: If enabled, user can set an overlay over the Image

item.label: Color on Default
item.description: Set an overlay color, it will be visible over the Image

item.label: Opacity
item.description: Define how transparent or opaque overlay color should be.

item.label: Enable Overlay
item.description: If enabled, an overlay color will be displayed over the image when the mouse hovers.

item.label: Color
item.description: Set a color. This color will be visible when the mouse hovers over the image.

item.label: Opacity
item.description: Define how transparent or opaque hover overlay color should be.

item.label: Styles
item.description: You can control the overlay style when the mouse hovers.

item.label: Text Content Reveal
item.description: You can control the Content when the mouse hovers.

item.label: Animation Delay
item.description: If you would like to add a delay before your animation runs you can designate that delay here in seconds. This can be useful when using multiple animated modules together.

item.label: Animation Time
item.description: You can control the arrival animation time of the hover overlay

item.label: Content
item.description: If enabled, you can set content on the hover overlay, it will be displayed with hover overlay when the mouse hovers.

item.label: Content Placement
item.description: You can control the placement of the hover overlay content

item.label: Content Alignment
item.description: You can control the hover overlay content alignment

item.label: Padding around content
item.description: You can set the padding around the hover overlay content

item.label: Enable Image Effect
item.description: If enabled, you can set few effects on image,this effect will be display when mouse hover

item.label: Effects
item.description: Choose an effect, its action will be visible when mouse hovers

item.label: Zooming Range
item.description: You can control the transition time of the Effects

item.label: Animation Duration (Sec)
item.description: You can control the Animation time of the Effect

item.label: Blur Out Animation Duration (Sec)
item.description: You can control the Animation Blur Out time of the Effect

item.label: Blur Level (px)
item.description: Blur by this amount.

item.label: Gray Scale Level (%)
item.description: You can control the Gray Scale of the Effect

item.label: Animation Speed Curve
item.description: Here you can adjust the easing method of your animation. Easing your animation in and out will create a smoother effect when compared to a linear speed curve.

item.label: Rotate Range (Degree)
item.description: Here you can adjust the rotation of your image.

item.label: Image Alignment
item.description: Here you can choose the image alignment.

item.label: Force Fullwidth
item.description: When enabled, this will force your image to extend 100% of the width of the column it's in.

item.label: Enable
item.description: If enabled, user can set a caption for the image

item.label: Text
item.description: Add caption for the image

item.label: Placement
item.description: You can control the placement of the caption

item.label: Background Color
item.description: Set background for the caption section

item.label: Padding
item.description: Set padding around the caption

item.label: Effect
item.description: Set effect when Image Reveal

item.label: Effect Delay (Sec)
item.description: If you would like to add a delay before your animation runs you can designate that delay here in seconds. This can be useful when using multiple animated modules together.

item.label: Effect Time (Sec)
item.description: If you would like to add a time of your animation runs you can designate that time here in seconds. This can be useful when using multiple animated modules together.
